high_level_description: stc brand style, a dusty desert landscape with a white camel before towering red-orange sandstone cliffs.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Towering layered red-orange sandstone cliffs with vertical striations, wind-blown sand creating a misty, dusty atmosphere, under a muted blue-gray sky.

elements.desc: A white camel standing on the sandy desert floor, dotted with small rocks and pebbles, serving as a scale reference against the cliffs.
